moments.t: Alisson gives it away, Havertz scores
moments.d: Alisson tries to play out from the back under pressure and doesn't find a teammate. Arsenal move it right and into the box, and Havertz finishes from six yards off Declan Rice's cross.

calls.t: Gakpo goes down under Tzolis, no penalty
calls.ctx: Tzolis's hands on Gakpo in the box · Madley waves it away, VAR checks and agrees
calls.d: Liverpool wanted a penalty. Gary Neville said it was the right call.
